name: main-gui-markdown
error: Markdown GUI open/edit exceeded its original 30-second deadline

markdown_performance.measurement: Detached production GUI; a 100 KB/5000-newline collapsed-heading input plus 1 MB single-line and unclosed-fence inputs, real WM_CHAR and Backspace, queued RIGHT/LEFT input and natural invalidated-region service requested after observing pending Markdown folds. Completion may follow pending work. Fixed 16-byte head/tail style samples, fold/status/length/dirty checks are not whole-content style proof. EOF caret/scroll requests ordinary native styling; no forced paint or full-document colourise. Elapsed time includes numeric status diagnostics and read-only process-memory sampling overhead. bulkLines/directLines count completed assignments, not distinct lines. ownedBufferBytes is the peak per-call owned plan/result capacity, not live process memory or total Ru/helper stack memory. bulkUs cumulatively measures the typed Apply FFI and result-wrapper interval per scan identity.

memory.measurement: Read-only K32GetProcessMemoryInfo on the already-owned child process handle, once per existing at-most-4-Hz GUI snapshot. sampledWorkingSetPeak is the maximum observed working set, not an instantaneous stage peak or RSS delta. processPeakWorkingSet is the OS cumulative process-lifetime peak, including earlier stages. External API cost is separate from synchronous GUI-message cost; stage elapsed and snapshot wall time include both.
